Quick walkthrough.text: Locate the hidden Legion cache west of Cottonwood Cove.

notes: As indicated by the disguised frumentarius when he interacts with the player character, any items left inside the cache boxes will be removed once the quest re-appears. However, items taken from the boxes and left on the ground nearby will remain indefinitely.

Additional "Legion Supply Cache" boxes will appear if the player's reputation with Caesar's Legion improves between each instance of this quest. Boxes will not disappear unless the player's reputation is not sufficient for another instance of the quest.
